scope: All nine inherited role definitions. Recommendations are not author/expert approval and not implemented existential axioms.

roles.recommended_design: Keep umbrella meaning; distinguish authorized manufacturing, contractual manufacturing responsibility and performed manufacturing participation.
roles.rejection_example: A registration, license, operation or source label alone must not assert a particular manufacturing occurrence.
roles.decision: Does the umbrella include commissioned/contract manufacturing without operating the physical site? Recommended: yes, if an explicit responsibility commitment is evidenced.

roles.recommended_design: Separate authorized use, assigned manufacturing function and participation in a concrete manufacturing event.
roles.rejection_example: A currently registered site may have no evidenced production event in the observation interval.
roles.decision: May a site retain its assigned function while idle? Recommended: yes; do not require an event at every snapshot.

roles.recommended_design: Distinguish import authorization from responsibility in a documented import context.
roles.rejection_example: Generic authorization does not establish import scope, and import permission does not establish a shipment.
roles.decision: Recommended: preserve a broad umbrella with separate permission/responsibility contexts, not a universal licensing axiom.

roles.recommended_design: Use explicit wholesale scope and separate actual distribution responsibility.
roles.rejection_example: Neither establishment registration nor a generic logistics activity proves wholesale distribution.
roles.decision: Recommended: explicit wholesale scope; do not infer ownership transfer or a shipment from licensure reporting.

roles.recommended_design: Model service responsibility separately from wholesale ownership/distribution and permission.
roles.rejection_example: Logistics services do not by themselves imply title to the pharmaceutical product.
roles.decision: Recommended: distinguish the service commitment from license evidence and from individual activities.

roles.recommended_design: A site function/use role; distinguish assigned distribution/storage use, authorization and activity occurrence.
roles.rejection_example: Facility operation alone does not make a site a distribution site; an idle distribution site need not lose its assigned function.
roles.decision: Recommended: a documented site-use context without asserting an actual shipment.

roles.recommended_design: Distinguish institutional mandate from exercising registration, authorization or oversight.
roles.rejection_example: An authority may hold its mandate before issuing any registration or license.
roles.decision: Recommended: a mandate context; do not define the parent as exactly the union of the three exercised-authority subroles.

roles.recommended_design: ListingResponsibleOrganizationRole is a subtype; the broader label/product responsibility may have additional contexts.
roles.rejection_example: A private labeler need not perform manufacturing; a broader responsibility role must not automatically create a market listing.
roles.decision: Recommended: retain the broad parent and the one-way listing subtype. Additional label-only contexts require their own definition.

roles.recommended_design: Distinguish reimbursement/funding commitment from publication of aggregate utilization observations.
roles.rejection_example: Publishing reimbursement counts does not establish the publisher as payer, patient identity, coverage entitlement or payment occurrence.
roles.decision: Recommended: an explicit funding/reimbursement commitment context; aggregate NHIF rows alone do not establish its full parties/cardinalities.
